name: Slip-Resistant Tile for Homes With Dogs and Older Adults
meta-description: Slip-resistant tile in plain English: what DCOF 0.42 means, textured vs polished finishes, and how we spec floors for dogs and older adults in Newcastle, WA.
post-summary: March 23, 2027 · Slip resistance is a measurable spec, not a vibe: wet DCOF of 0.42 or higher wherever water lands, texture over gloss, mosaic in the shower. How we spec floors for big dogs and for aging in place, the cleaning trade-off nobody mentions, and why no tile is honestly slip-proof.
